qa_pairs.question: How has the tax exemption limit for baggage brought by land-route passengers changed over time, and what recent restriction was introduced to regulate this benefit?
qa_pairs.answer: The tax exemption limit for baggage imported by passengers arriving via land routes was initially set at $300 USD (as seen in clauses [0], [1], and [2]). This was subsequently increased to $400 USD (as seen in clauses [3], [4], [5], [6], [7], and [8]). Additionally, a frequency restriction was introduced in 2023, stipulating that passengers cannot receive this duty-free baggage benefit more than 3 times per calendar year (as seen in clauses [5], [6], [7], and [8]).
